title: 2013 - Asia Smartphone Contest
author: hkwtia
plainText: To recognize the excellence of innovative smartphone applications development and provide a platform for top smartphone applications professionals in the region to meet, share, collaborate and learn from each other, WTIA started to organize Asia Smartphone Contest in 2013. 7 Asia Regions, including Israel, Mainland China, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan was the co-organizer of the Contest.
